cues.en: Until recently, the vast majority of the world population worked on farms, and the total production of the world's economy was mostly the total agricultural
cues.zh: 直到最近，世界绝大多数人口都在农场劳作，全球经济的总产出主要就是农业总产出

cues.en: output.
cues.zh: 产出。

cues.en: And this output was limited by the fixed size of the land.
cues.zh: 而这种产出受到土地固定面积的限制。

cues.en: The total output of the economy did not change a lot year by year.
cues.zh: 经济总产出年复一年变化不大。

cues.en: The size of the pie was fixed.
cues.zh: 蛋糕的大小是固定的。

cues.en: The world was a zero sum game.
cues.zh: 世界是零和博弈。

cues.en: In such a stagnating world, the only way to get better off is if someone else gets worse off.
cues.zh: 在这样一个停滞的世界里，想要过得更好，唯一的办法就是让别人过得更糟。

cues.en: If you take a bigger piece of the pie, someone else's gets smaller.
cues.zh: 如果你拿走更大的一块蛋糕，别人的那块就会变小。

cues.en: If you want more food, then conquering, plundering, and stealing are great strategies.
cues.zh: 如果你想要更多食物，那么征服、掠夺和偷窃都是很好的策略。

cues.en: Your neighbor's loss is your gain.
cues.zh: 邻居的损失就是你的收益。

cues.en: This was the state of things for thousands of years.
cues.zh: 几千年来，情况一直如此。

cues.en: Societies invaded each other constantly to get more pie.
cues.zh: 各个社会不断相互入侵，以获得更多的蛋糕。

cues.en: Economic inequality was extreme.
cues.zh: 经济不平等极其严重。

cues.en: Some had all the pie they wanted,
cues.zh: 有些人想要多少蛋糕就有多少，

cues.en: while others had to live with the crumbs.
cues.zh: 而另一些人只能靠残羹剩饭度日。

cues.en: Then the industrial revolution happened, and everything changed.
cues.zh: 然后工业革命发生了，一切都改变了。

cues.en: We developed machinery,
cues.zh: 我们发明了机械，

cues.en: better crops, better fertilizers.
cues.zh: 培育了更好的作物，生产了更好的肥料。

cues.en: Agricultural
cues.zh: 农业

cues.en: output skyrocketed.
cues.zh: 产出飞速增长。

cues.en: But we didn't just produce more food, every industrial sector exploded in terms of productivity.
cues.zh: 但我们生产的不只是更多食物，每个工业部门的生产率都实现了爆炸式增长。

cues.en: From 1700
the production of iron in Britain increased 137
cues.zh: 英国的铁产量增长了 137

cues.en: fold.
cues.zh: 倍。

cues.en: The industrial revolution led to a previously unimaginable
cues.zh: 工业革命带来了过去难以想象的

cues.en: increase in economic output.
cues.zh: 经济产出增长。

cues.en: This altered the nature of our societies.
cues.zh: 这改变了我们社会的性质。

cues.en: Economic growth changed the world from a zero sum game to a positive sum game.
cues.zh: 经济增长让世界从零和博弈变成了正和博弈。

cues.en: We had found a way to create a bigger pie. But not only a bigger pie, but a pie that was growing bigger each year.
cues.zh: 我们找到了做大蛋糕的方法，而且不只是更大的蛋糕，还是每年都在变大的蛋糕。

cues.en: More people could have more at the same time.
cues.zh: 更多人能同时拥有更多。

cues.en: This development is spreading and continuing today. Antibiotics kill bacteria.
cues.zh: 这种发展正在蔓延，并持续到今天。抗生素杀死细菌。

cues.en: Power plants deliver energy. Cell phones connect us. Planes let us travel cheaply. Fridges store food.
cues.zh: 发电厂输送能源。手机连接你我。飞机让我们廉价出行。冰箱储存食物。

cues.en: Continuous progress in all sectors of the economy seems normal to us today,
cues.zh: 如今，经济各领域的持续进步对我们来说已是常态，

cues.en: but the change from stagnation to economic growth really was the most drastic shift in human history. How was this possible?
cues.zh: 但从停滞到经济增长的转变，确实是人类历史上最剧烈的变革。这怎么可能？

cues.en: At the very core of this massive transformation
cues.zh: 在这场巨变的核心，

cues.en: stand new ideas that lead to innovation.
cues.zh: 是催生创新的新思想。

cues.en: Innovation has many different definitions,
cues.zh: 创新有很多不同的定义，

cues.en: but in the context of this video, we mean better solutions to existing problems and solutions to problems we didn't know we had.
cues.zh: 但在本视频的语境中，我们指的是对现有问题的更好解决方案，以及对我们不知道自己拥有的问题的解决方案。

cues.en: The more you innovate,
cues.zh: 你越创新，

cues.en: the more complex and interesting problems you discover as your wishes and needs evolve.
cues.zh: 随着你的愿望和需求不断演变，你发现的问题就越复杂、越有趣。

cues.en: The average citizen in Norway two hundred and fifty years ago might have wanted some really good shoes.
cues.zh: 两百五十年前，挪威的普通公民可能想要一双真正的好鞋。

cues.en: A hundred and fifty years ago, maybe a bicycle.
cues.zh: 一百五十年前，也许是一辆自行车。

cues.en: Eighty years ago, a car.
cues.zh: 八十年前，一辆汽车。

cues.en: Thirty years ago, cheap air travel,
cues.zh: 三十年前，廉价的航空旅行，

cues.en: and so on.
cues.zh: 以此类推。

cues.en: Once we get what we want, we don't stop.
cues.zh: 一旦得到想要的，我们不会停下。

cues.en: We can see how we can improve things even more and how to make things even better.
cues.zh: 我们能看到如何进一步改进，如何让事情变得更好。

cues.en: The new positive sum world has existed for 0.1%
cues.zh: 这个新的正和世界只存在了人类历史的0.1%，

cues.en: of human history, and we have yet to get used to it. It has a consequence that feels really unintuitive.
cues.zh: 而我们还没习惯它。它带来的一个后果非常反直觉。

cues.en: In a positive sum world,
cues.zh: 在一个正和世界里，

cues.en: it's in your personal, selfish best interest that every human on planet Earth is well off. It's good for you if people in obscure parts of countries you've never heard of are prospering.
cues.zh: 让地球上的每个人都过得好，符合你个人、自私的最大利益。即使是你从未听说过的国家里偏远地区的人变得富裕，对你也有好处。

cues.en: There is a genuine selfish argument
cues.zh: 确实有一个真实的自私理由

cues.en: for making the world a better place.
cues.zh: 去让世界变得更好。

cues.en: In a positive sum world, the more people are well off, the better your own life is.
cues.zh: 在一个正和世界里，越多人过得好，你自己的生活就越好。

cues.en: This is because of the nature of innovation.
cues.zh: 这是因为创新的本质。

cues.en: It is fundamentally driven by supply and demand.
cues.zh: 它从根本上由供需驱动。

cues.en: The supply increases when more people have the freedom and education to contribute.
cues.zh: 当更多人有自由和受教育机会去贡献时，供给就会增加。

cues.en: They become inventors,
cues.zh: 他们成为发明家、

cues.en: researchers,
cues.zh: 研究者、

cues.en: engineers,
cues.zh: 工程师、

cues.en: or thinkers that come up with new ideas.
cues.zh: 或提出新想法的思想家。

cues.en: The demand for ideas increases as people get richer and can pay for new solutions.
cues.zh: 随着人们变得更富有、能支付新解决方案，对想法的需求会增加。

cues.en: They increase the size of the market for innovations.
cues.zh: 他们扩大了创新的市场规模。

cues.en: Innovation follows incentives.
cues.zh: 创新会追随激励。

cues.en: So
cues.zh: 所以

cues.en: naturally, if many people want and can pay for something, it will get the innovator's attention and energy.
cues.zh: 自然，如果很多人想要并且买得起某样东西，它就会吸引创新者的注意力和精力。

cues.en: Improving the lives of those who are worst off has a multiplying effect.
cues.zh: 改善处境最差者的生活会产生乘数效应。

cues.en: It increases demand for ideas while at the same time making it easier for ideas to be produced.
cues.zh: 它既增加了对想法的需求，同时也让想法更容易产生。

cues.en: Let's take an example that interests all of us, a cure for cancer.
cues.zh: 让我们举一个大家都感兴趣的例子：癌症的治愈方法。

cues.en: If there are 1,000,000,000 people in the world that have the wealth to pay for cancer treatments, innovation will follow this demand.
cues.zh: 如果世界上有 10 亿人拥有支付癌症治疗费用的财富，创新就会追随这一需求。

cues.en: So hundreds of billions of dollars have been invested in medical research.
cues.zh: 因此，数千亿美元已被投入到医学研究中。

cues.en: This had a huge effect, but we're still nowhere near to curing all forms of cancer.
cues.zh: 这产生了巨大影响，但我们仍远未治愈所有形式的癌症。

cues.en: Today, every sixth person in the world dies of cancer, and you might be one of them.
cues.zh: 今天，世界上每六个人中就有一人死于癌症，而你可能就是其中之一。

cues.en: Now imagine if demand were higher.
cues.zh: 现在想象一下，如果需求更高会怎样。

cues.en: Imagine instead of 1,000,000,000 people being able to pay for a cure for cancer, there were 4,000,000,000 or 7,000,000,000.
cues.zh: 想象一下，不是10亿人能负担得起癌症疗法，而是40亿或70亿人。

cues.en: Imagine how far medicine could have developed if we'd invested seven times as much in curing cancer.
cues.zh: 想象一下，如果我们在治愈癌症上投入七倍的资金，医学能发展到什么程度。

cues.en: On top of that, there's so much human potential being wasted right now.
cues.zh: 除此之外，现在有太多人类潜能被浪费了。

cues.en: The work of a poor farmer in a developing nation is not useful to you. But if he becomes better off, his children might spend their time in university
cues.zh: 一个发展中国家贫穷农民的工作对你没有用。但如果他生活改善，他的孩子也许会上大学，

cues.en: developing things that are useful to you. Instead of having some hotspots of innovation in the developed world, we would have many hotspots all over the world.
cues.zh: 开发对你有用的东西。不再是发达国家只有少数创新热点，而是世界各地都有许多创新热点。

cues.en: The research output of humanity would be many times what it is right now.
cues.zh: 人类的研究产出会是现在的许多倍。

cues.en: Could we have cured cancer by now if that were the case? Well, maybe. If we spent seven times as much on research, had seven times as many people working on it, and a global network of medical research, things would certainly be further ahead than they are now.
cues.zh: 如果是那样，我们到现在能治愈癌症吗？嗯，也许吧。如果我们在研究上投入七倍资金，有七倍的人从事研究，并建立全球医学研究网络，进展肯定会比现在更远。

cues.en: And this is the core of the argument. The more people want the same thing that you want, the more likely you are to get it.
cues.zh: 这就是论证的核心。越多人和你想要同样的东西，你就越可能得到它。

cues.en: That is what it means to live in a positive sum world.
cues.zh: 这就是生活在正和世界中的意义。

cues.en: You don't gain more pie if poor places stay poor. Instead, you get more pie if poor places get richer, contribute ideas,
cues.zh: 如果贫困地区一直贫困，你并不会分到更多蛋糕。相反，只有贫困地区变得更富裕，贡献想法，

cues.en: and grow the global pie.
cues.zh: 全球蛋糕才会做大。

cues.en: Would you like space travel?
cues.zh: 你想去太空旅行吗？

cues.en: Imagine there were billions of people in Africa and Asia with their own space programs and demand for satellites and moon bases and cities on Mars.
cues.zh: 想象一下，非洲和亚洲有数十亿人拥有自己的太空计划，对卫星、月球基地和火星城市有需求。

cues.en: Do you like being alive? A few billion people paying for medical research could literally save your life.
cues.zh: 你喜欢活着吗？数十亿人为医学研究付费，真的可能救你的命。

cues.en: It's in your interest for people around the world to become better off.
cues.zh: 世界各地的人们变得更富裕，符合你的利益。

cues.en: The faster we get to this version of the world, the better for you personally.
cues.zh: 我们越快到达这个世界版本，对你个人就越好。

cues.en: No matter what your motivation is, working on a better world is a very good thing to do for others
cues.zh: 无论你的动机是什么，为一个更美好的世界而努力，对他人来说都是一件非常好的事，

cues.en: and for you.
cues.zh: 对你自己也是如此。
